reviews.reply: That means a lot to our team to hear! Accurate mileage really does make a difference when costs like gas are changing, and we’re glad Everlance has been there when it counts. Thanks for trusting us and for sharing this.

reviews.text: Not free
reviews.reply:
Everlance is free to use, we appreciate this feedback.

We have three plans available. Basic, which is free, and then Starter and Professional, which are paid and unlock additional features to save time and money. Upgrading is entirely optional.

reviews.text: Very easy to use and plenty of options to customize! Essential for delivery drivers.
reviews.reply: Love hearing this. Customization matters when every drive is different, and we’re glad Everlance fits delivery work so well. Thanks for the support and for trusting us with your miles.

reviews.text: so much help with ride share work
reviews.reply:
Story time about Everlance..if you look up our founders and why they started Everlance, it was because they couldn't find an app that helped track miles & expenses as a rideshare driver, so they built one!

11 years later, here we are. Thank you for the review :)

reviews.text: easy to use to track mileage for varioys purposes.
reviews.reply: Appreciate the kind words! We’re glad Everlance makes it easy to track mileage for all the different reasons you drive. Thanks for using the app.

reviews.text: app often doesn't record driving so a lot of mileage/deductions are lost
reviews.reply: Thanks for the feedback. This is often quickly solvable by reviewing settings and getting things set up properly. Please reach out to support@everlance.com so we can help you fix this right away.

reviews.text: Love having my trips automatically recorded. All I have to do is classify my trip at the end. Makes reporting on your taxes easier. You don't have to calculate anything.
reviews.reply: That’s exactly the goal. Set it and forget it, then a quick swipe at the end. No math, no spreadsheets, no second guessing. We’re glad automatic mileage tracking is making things easier for you. Thanks for the 5 stars!

reviews.text: This one is great much better than the one I had before,cheaper too.
reviews.reply: Love hearing that. Welcome aboard. Thank you for making the switch and for the 5 stars!

reviews.text: Quick and easy
reviews.reply: Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. Glad to hear things are going according to the "quick and easy" plan!

reviews.text: It was good, but now it doesn't work anymore. It doesn't auto detect your mileage and I cannot remember how many miles I drove. This app was supposed to do it for me automatically and lately it hasn't been recording anything at all. Putting all my hard work down the drain. I don't recommend PAYING for this useless app.
reviews.reply: We hear how frustrating this is, especially when you’re relying on auto tracking. When trips aren’t recorded, it defeats the purpose. This is often caused by a device or settings issue, and we’d really like to help fix it. Please reach out to support@everlance.com so we can take a closer look.

reviews.text: worst tracking app. can't even download my mileage from last year. tried multiple times & it keeps giving this years even after changing the dates to last year. would not use ever again
reviews.reply: That’s frustrating to hear for us. Exporting the wrong date range isn’t expected behavior. We’d really like to help sort this out and get you the correct mileage. Please reach out to support@everlance.com so we can take a closer look and fix it.

reviews.text: Quick & easy milage expensing
reviews.reply: Thanks for the 5 stars! We’re glad mileage & expense tracking feels quick and easy. That’s exactly what we’re here for.

reviews.text: great app
reviews.reply: Thanks for the love! 🙌

reviews.text: not really glow in my app collection
reviews.reply: Thanks for the honest feedback. We appreciate you giving Everlance a try, and we’re always working to make it stand out more. If there’s something specific that would make it shine for you, we’re all ears at support@everlance.com.

reviews.text: Yearly subscriber and now the app will start a trip, stop the trip less than a mile away then not record any other trips for the rest of the day. I can't get a reply from the company either.
reviews.reply: Trips stopping early and missing the rest of the day is not acceptable, and we hear you on the lack of response too. Please reach out again to support@everlance.com and mention this review so we can escalate and help get this resolved.

reviews.text: Not actually free. Requires monthly payment after a few weeks. No other version.
reviews.reply:
Thanks for sharing this. Just to clarify, Everlance does have a free Basic plan that’s free forever. It includes manual GPS trip tracking and limited automatic trips.

Paid plans are optional and unlock extras like unlimited auto tracking and advanced features. If anything felt unclear, we’re happy to explain at support@everlance.com.
